info.title: Syscat inventory API
info.description: Create and search inventory, read records and photographs, attach photos, and PATCH current text and photo metadata. Writes currently use trusted-network access. Asset IDs are sequential but may be explicitly moved or swapped after acknowledging that page/API URLs break or identify another asset. Schema 4 adopts current displayed catalog numbers as IDs. Original intake and image file URLs stay with their records. Revisions and current target expectations guard writes; they are not permanent record identities.

get.description: API index with links to the inventory and OpenAPI description. /api/ is an alias.

Descending current asset IDs. Renumbering breaks or reassigns asset URLs; catalog_number is an alias for id. Defaults to active records. Unknown, repeated, or invalid query parameters return 400. Original intake is omitted from listing items; fetch the individual record for it. Previous and next links are omitted when unavailable. Use view=summary for compact catalog review without description bodies, locations, timestamps, or photo metadata; follow api_url for full context. Pagination retains the selected view. Omitting view preserves the existing full response. Use field to restrict q to titles, descriptions, locations, captions, or IDs. Pagination preserves explicit field selection.

parameters.name: q
parameters.description: Case-insensitive description/location/current-caption substring, or exact numeric current asset ID (optional zero padding). field=catalog_number is a compatibility alias for field=id.

parameters.name: archived
parameters.description: Select archived records instead of active records. Empty is equivalent to false.

parameters.name: view
parameters.description: Response projection. Summary records contain identity, display title, revision, photo count, archive state, and record links.

parameters.name: field
parameters.description: Restrict q to one current field. title and short_description search the complete short description; details searches longer notes only; description searches the legacy combined projection; location/caption/id/catalog_number retain their documented behavior. Empty q lists the selected archive set.

post.summary: Create an asset with original intake and photos
post.description: Trusted-network multipart creation without cookies or CSRF tokens. Requires a single-line short_description (or legacy description) and exactly one overview photo. Optional details and location, overview caption, detail photos, detail captions, and groups are optional. Uses the shared image metadata stripping/thumbnail pipeline and captures original intake. Returns revision 1. Optional Idempotency-Key identifies a logical creation: first successful creation wins; replay returns that record in its current state with 200, ignoring replacement content after basic request validation. Keys persist across restarts and archiving. Use a new key for each different creation. Without a key, every successful request creates a new asset. A failed creation does not reserve a key. Unknown fields and query parameters are rejected.

parameters.name: Idempotency-Key
parameters.description: Optional persistent retry key. 1–128 ASCII letters, digits, dots, underscores, or hyphens. Must appear once; case sensitive. Do not reuse for another logical creation.

201.description: Created asset including current asset ID, stable photo IDs and image-file URLs, original intake, and revision 1.

Location.description: Root-relative URL of the updated asset.

400.description: Missing description/overview, malformed multipart request, invalid idempotency key or metadata, unknown/duplicate fields, or invalid image.

413.description: Request exceeds configured max-upload-mib (default 256 MiB), or a photo exceeds 12 MiB.

200.description: Idempotent replay: current record created by this key, including later edits or archived status. No duplicate images or records.

Location.description: Root-relative URL of the updated asset.

get.description: Includes original intake. Archived records are readable by ID. Accepts numeric IDs with or without zero padding.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: Positive inventory ID within signed 64-bit range.

patch.description: Trusted-network write; no credentials or browser session required. Query parameters are not accepted. Photo PATCH returns the full updated asset. IDs, intake, timestamps, files, order, and archive state cannot be directly overwritten. Independently PATCH short_description or details while preserving the omitted field. Legacy description is still accepted but cannot be mixed with split fields.

200.description: Updated full asset with its incremented revision.

400.description: Invalid body, unsupported fields, or invalid edits.

404.description: Asset or attached photo not found.

409.description: Stale revision or archived asset. Read the latest asset before retrying.

parameters.name: name
parameters.description: Filename from a returned photo URL.

parameters.name: name
parameters.description: Filename from a returned photo URL.

patch.summary: Edit a photo caption or group
patch.description: Trusted-network write; no credentials or browser session required. Query parameters are not accepted. Photo PATCH returns the full updated asset. IDs, intake, timestamps, files, order, and archive state cannot be directly overwritten.

parameters.name: photo_id
parameters.description: Use the stable id from a current photo, or follow its api_url.

200.description: Updated full asset with its incremented revision.

400.description: Invalid body, unsupported fields, or invalid edits.

404.description: Asset or attached photo not found.

409.description: Stale revision or archived asset. Read the latest asset before retrying.

post.summary: Attach photos to an existing asset
post.description: Trusted-network multipart upload without cookies or CSRF tokens. Requires the current asset revision. One or more photos are saved as one revision, with optional captions and groups aligned by file order. Preserves existing overview, metadata, and original intake. Reuses image validation, metadata stripping, and thumbnail generation. On any failure the entire batch is rejected and its generated files removed. Concurrent changes return 409; reread and reconcile before retrying. No query parameters accepted.

201.description: Full updated asset with stable photo IDs and new revision. New files are assigned detail roles; the existing overview is retained. For a legacy asset with no photos, its first attachment becomes the ungrouped overview.

Location.description: Root-relative URL of the updated asset.

400.description: Malformed multipart request, missing or invalid revision, invalid metadata, or unsupported/invalid image.

413.description: Request exceeds configured max-upload-mib (default 256 MiB), or a photo exceeds 12 MiB.

post.summary: Legacy route alias for changing the asset ID
post.description: Changes the actual asset ID, breaking existing links. Requires acknowledge_link_changes=true and the current source revision. Supply current target swap_id and swap_revision when occupied; omit both when free. Changes are transactional. Archived sources cannot be renumbered; archived targets may swap and remain archived. Returns updated records with new URLs and Location pointing to the source API URL. Photos and original intake remain attached to their records; image file URLs stay unchanged. Old asset URLs return 404 for a move or identify the other asset after a swap. Body limit 128 KiB; no query parameters. id and catalog_number are mutually exclusive request aliases.

200.description: ID changed or no-op; source has new URLs; swapped_asset only present for a swap.

Location.description: New API URL of the source asset.

400.description: Invalid fields, invalid ID, or missing/false link-change acknowledgment.

409.description: Stale revision, archived source, or target assignment changed/expected occupant not supplied.

post.summary: Move or swap an asset ID (breaks existing links)
post.description: Changes the actual asset ID, breaking existing links. Requires acknowledge_link_changes=true and the current source revision. Supply current target swap_id and swap_revision when occupied; omit both when free. Changes are transactional. Archived sources cannot be renumbered; archived targets may swap and remain archived. Returns updated records with new URLs and Location pointing to the source API URL. Photos and original intake remain attached to their records; image file URLs stay unchanged. Old asset URLs return 404 for a move or identify the other asset after a swap. Body limit 128 KiB; no query parameters. id and catalog_number are mutually exclusive request aliases.

200.description: ID changed or no-op; source has new URLs; swapped_asset only present for a swap.

Location.description: New API URL of the source asset.

400.description: Invalid fields, invalid ID, or missing/false link-change acknowledgment.

409.description: Stale revision, archived source, or target assignment changed/expected occupant not supplied.

original_url.description: Root-relative URL for the original image.

thumbnail_url.description: Root-relative URL for the display thumbnail.

caption.description: Optional photo caption; empty when not supplied.

group.description: Photo group name. Empty for the overview and ungrouped detail photos. Named groups appear in saved order, followed by ungrouped details.

id.description: Stable opaque photo ID, independent of ordering, caption, group, and overview role.

api_url.description: PATCH endpoint for this photo; returns the updated asset.

id.description: Current sequential asset ID, used in URLs. Explicit renumbering changes it and breaks or reassigns previous links.

label.description: Current asset ID padded to at least five digits, without a prefix.

title.description: Display title derived from short_description, with the existing 120-character display truncation. Read short_description for its complete text.

description.description: Legacy combined description compatibility field. Read projection is derived from short_description and details using a single LF separator when details are nonempty; original intake retains its original text. On writes, split first line into short_description and the remainder into details. Limited to 20,000 UTF-8 bytes; do not mix with either new field.

photos.description: Current display order; first photo is the selected overview.

original_intake.description: Stored initial snapshot, only included on individual records. Photo paths are relative to the server root. The snapshot ID may be 0 because it predates ID allocation; use the outer record ID.

photo_upload_url.description: Upload endpoint for the current asset ID; changes on renumbering.

catalog_number.description: Deprecated compatibility alias equal to current id; no separate number is stored.

catalog_number_url.description: Deprecated route alias for id_change_url, with identical link-breaking behavior.

short_description.description: Required single-line short description, trimmed on writes, at most 20,000 UTF-8 bytes. Supplies the display title.

details.description: Longer details/research notes with whitespace and paragraph formatting preserved, at most 20,000 UTF-8 bytes. Empty string clears; omitted PATCH preserves existing notes.

id_change_url.description: POST endpoint for explicit ID moves/swaps; requires acknowledgment of broken links.

field.description: Selected search field. Present only when field is supplied in the request.

summaries.description: Compact catalog listing for agent review.

write_authentication.description: API writes currently permit trusted-network clients without credentials.

AssetPatch.description: Include revision and at least one editable field. Omitted fields stay unchanged. Null and duplicate fields are rejected; text is trimmed. Maximum request body 128 KiB.

revision.description: Current asset revision from GET or a previous successful PATCH.

description.description: Legacy combined description compatibility field. Read projection is derived from short_description and details using a single LF separator when details are nonempty; original intake retains its original text. On writes, split first line into short_description and the remainder into details. Limited to 20,000 UTF-8 bytes; do not mix with either new field.

location.description: Optional location, maximum 500 UTF-8 bytes after trimming. Empty string clears it.

short_description.description: Required single-line short description, trimmed on writes, at most 20,000 UTF-8 bytes. Supplies the display title.

details.description: Longer details/research notes with whitespace and paragraph formatting preserved, at most 20,000 UTF-8 bytes. Empty string clears; omitted PATCH preserves existing notes.

PhotoPatch.description: Include revision and at least one editable field. Omitted fields stay unchanged. Null and duplicate fields are rejected; text is trimmed. Maximum request body 128 KiB.

revision.description: Current asset revision from GET or a previous successful PATCH.

group.description: Single-line case-sensitive group name. Empty string makes a detail photo ungrouped. The overview cannot join a named group. Saving normalizes group order.

id.description: Current sequential asset ID, used in URLs. Explicit renumbering changes it and breaks or reassigns previous links.

label.description: Current asset ID padded to at least five digits, without a prefix.

photo_count.description: Number of photos currently attached, including the overview.

catalog_number.description: Deprecated compatibility alias equal to current id; no separate number is stored.

AssetSummary.description: Compact current record. Title uses the usual display-title truncation; retrieve the full description via api_url before editing.

field.description: Selected search field. Present only when field is supplied in the request.

AssetSummaryList.description: Summary projection of a listing; pagination links retain view=summary and other filters.

photos.description: Repeat this file part for multiple photos. JPEG, PNG, GIF only. Each photo at most 12 MiB and 32 megapixels. Total request at most max-upload-mib (256 MiB by default).

caption_photos.description: Omit entirely, or repeat once per photo in photos file order. Use empty strings for uncaptioned files. Text is trimmed.

group_photos.description: Omit entirely, or repeat once per photo in photos file order. Use empty strings for ungrouped files. Trimmed, single-line names. Existing named group order retained, new groups follow in encounter order, ungrouped details last.

photos.description: Optional detail photos. Repeat photos for multiple files. JPEG/PNG/GIF only; at most 12 MiB and 32 megapixels each. Total request at most max-upload-mib (default 256 MiB).

caption_photos.description: Omit entirely, or repeat once per photo in photos file order. Use empty strings for uncaptioned files. Text is trimmed.

group_photos.description: Omit entirely, or repeat once per photo in photos file order. Use empty strings for ungrouped files. Trimmed, single-line names. Existing named group order retained, new groups follow in encounter order, ungrouped details last.

description.description: Legacy combined description compatibility field. Read projection is derived from short_description and details using a single LF separator when details are nonempty; original intake retains its original text. On writes, split first line into short_description and the remainder into details. Limited to 20,000 UTF-8 bytes; do not mix with either new field.

location.description: Optional trimmed location, at most 500 UTF-8 bytes.

overview.description: Exactly one required overview photo, separate from detail photos; always ungrouped. Same format, size, and metadata handling as photos.

caption_overview.description: Optional trimmed caption for the overview; submit at most once.

short_description.description: Required single-line short description, trimmed on writes, at most 20,000 UTF-8 bytes. Supplies the display title.

details.description: Longer details/research notes with whitespace and paragraph formatting preserved, at most 20,000 UTF-8 bytes. Empty string clears; omitted PATCH preserves existing notes.

catalog_number.description: Deprecated request alias for id; supply exactly one of them.

swap_id.description: Current asset ID occupying the requested target. Required together with swap_revision when occupied; omit both when free.

swap_revision.description: Current revision of the target occupant; protects the second asset from stale swaps.

id.description: Requested positive asset ID. Changes page and API URLs.

acknowledge_link_changes.description: Required acknowledgment that changing IDs breaks or reassigns existing asset/API links.

CatalogNumberResult.description: Source record and optional swapped occupant after ID changes, with new IDs/URLs. Original intake and image files stay with their records.
